snippet.title: Stuck in the Sewers // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4549380/Stuck_in_the_Sewers

Stuck in the Sewers is a puzzle-adventure game where you push, turn and reshape pipes to carve your way forward. Unlock new abilities, discover areas with unique mechanics and tools, and explore a world interconnected by a vast sewer system.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Julio Maass
📚 Publisher: Julio Maass
📅 Release Date: Coming Soon
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie
